def set_cell(cell, lines, bold_first=False):
    if isinstance(lines, str):
        lines = [lines]
    cell.text = ""
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        p = cell.paragraphs[0] if i == 0 else cell.add_paragraph()
        run = p.add_run(line)
        if i == 0 and bold_first:
            run.bold = True
    cell.vertical_alignment = WD_ALIGN_VERTICAL.TOP


def add_two_col(doc, rows):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=len(rows), cols=2)
    t.style = TABLE_STYLE
    t.columns[0].width = Inches(1.8)
    t.columns[1].width = Inches(4.7)
    for i, (label, content) in enumerate(rows):
        set_cell(t.rows[i].cells[0], label, bold_first=True)
        if isinstance(content, str):

    doc.add_paragraph()

def _format_unicode(prompt):
    prompt = (prompt
              .replace("\u00e2\u2020\u2019", "\u2192")
              .replace("\u00e2\u20ac\u201d", "\u2014")
              .replace("\u00e2\u20ac\u201c", "\u2013"))
    SUPS = {"2": "\u00b2", "3": "\u00b3", "4": "\u2074",
            "5": "\u2075", "6": "\u2076"}
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(prompt):
        ch = prompt[i]
        if ch == "^" and i + 1 < len(prompt) and prompt[i+1] in SUPS:
            out.append(SUPS[prompt[i+1]])
            i += 2
            continue
        out.append("\u2212" if ch == "-" else ch)
        i += 1
    return "".join(out)


def _strip_stem(prompt):
    txt = _format_unicode(prompt)
    if ":" in txt:
        txt = txt.split(":", 1)[-1].strip()
    return txt.rstrip(".")

def _format_unicode(prompt):
    prompt = (prompt
              .replace("\u00e2\u2020\u2019", "\u2192")
              .replace("\u00e2\u20ac\u201d", "\u2014")
              .replace("\u00e2\u20ac\u201c", "\u2013"))
    SUPS = {"2": "\u00b2", "3": "\u00b3", "4": "\u2074",
            "5": "\u2075", "6": "\u2076"}
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(prompt):
        ch = prompt[i]
        if ch == "^" and i + 1 < len(prompt) and prompt[i+1] in SUPS:
            out.append(SUPS[prompt[i+1]])
            i += 2
            continue
        out.append("\u2212" if ch == "-" else ch)
        i += 1
    return "".join(out)


def _fmt(text):
    """Alias for _format_unicode for convenience."""
    return _format_unicode(str(text))

def _format_unicode(prompt: str) -> str:
    prompt = (prompt
              .replace("\u00e2\u2020\u2019", "\u2192")
              .replace("\u00e2\u20ac\u201d", "\u2014")
              .replace("\u00e2\u20ac\u201c", "\u2013")
              .replace("\u00c2\u00b1", "\u00b1")
              .replace("\u00e2\u02c6\u0161", "\u221a"))
    SUPS = {"2": "\u00b2", "3": "\u00b3", "4": "\u2074",
            "5": "\u2075", "6": "\u2076"}
    out, i = [], 0
    while i < len(prompt):
        ch = prompt[i]
        if ch == "^" and i + 1 < len(prompt) and prompt[i+1] in SUPS:
            out.append(SUPS[prompt[i+1]])
            i += 2
            continue
        out.append("\u2212" if ch == "-" else ch)
        i += 1
    return "".join(out)


def _strip_stem(prompt: str) -> str:
    txt = _format_unicode(prompt)
    if ":" in txt:
        txt = txt.split(":", 1)[-1].strip()
    return txt.rstrip(".")

const TRANSITION_WINDOW = 60;

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const state = {

function setMode(m) {
  state.mode = m;
  const f = $("mode-fishing"), r = $("mode-racing"), note = $("mode-note");
  if (f && r && note) {
    f.classList.toggle("on", m === "fishing");
    r.classList.toggle("on", m === "racing");
    note.textContent = m === "fishing"
      ? "First time this week \u2014 Fishing Frenzy keeps energy playful."
      : "Repeat day \u2014 Racing is more rigorous; use when students need the faster pace.";
  }
}
window.setMode = setMode;

function fmt(s) {
  s = Math.max(0, Math.round(s));
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  const ss = s % 60;
  return `${m}:${ss.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function hueForRemaining(remaining, duration) {
  const frac = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, remaining / duration));
  return Math.round(210 * frac);
}

function renderDots() {
  const dots = $("dots");
  dots.innerHTML = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < PHASES.length; i++) {
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.className = "dot" + (i < state.idx ? " done" : i === state.idx ? " current" : "");
    dots.appendChild(d);
  }
}

function currentSubstep(phase, remaining) {
  if (!phase.substeps || !phase.substeps.length) return null;
  const elapsed = phase.duration - remaining;
  let acc = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < phase.substeps.length; i++) {
    acc += phase.substeps[i].sec;
    if (elapsed < acc) {
      return {index: i, remainingInStep: acc - elapsed};
    }
  }
  return {index: phase.substeps.length - 1, remainingInStep: 0};
}

function renderSubsteps() {
  const p = PHASES[state.idx];
  const list = $("substep-list");
  list.innerHTML = "";
  if (!p.substeps) return;
  const cur = currentSubstep(p, state.remaining);
  p.substeps.forEach((s, i) => {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    let cls = "substep";
    if (cur && i < cur.index) cls += " done";
    else if (cur && i === cur.index) cls += " current";
    div.className = cls;
    const text = document.createElement("div");
    text.className = "substep-text";
    text.textContent = s.label;
    const time = document.createElement("div");
    time.className = "substep-time";
    if (cur && i === cur.index) {
      time.textContent = fmt(cur.remainingInStep);
    } else {
      time.textContent = fmt(s.sec);
    }
    div.appendChild(text);
    div.appendChild(time);
    list.appendChild(div);
  });
}

function renderPhase() {
  const p = PHASES[state.idx];
  $("phase-meta").textContent = `Phase ${state.idx + 1} of ${PHASES.length}  \u00b7  Algebra 2  \u00b7  Lesson 3-5  \u00b7  Combined Day 7 (Savvas-only)`;
  $("phase-title").innerHTML =

    `<span class="badge" style="background:#555">${Math.round(p.duration/60)} min</span>` +
    `</span>`;
  $("instructions").innerHTML = p.instructions;
  $("transition-text").textContent = p.transition || "";
  renderDots();
  update();
  if (p.framework === "Do Now B") setMode(state.mode);
}

function update() {
  const p = PHASES[state.idx];
  const hue = hueForRemaining(state.remaining, p.duration);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--hue", hue);

  const pct = 100 * (1 - state.remaining / p.duration);
  $("progress-fill").style.width = pct.toFixed(1) + "%";
  $("timer").textContent = fmt(state.remaining);

  const transitionEl = $("transition");
  if (state.remaining <= TRANSITION_WINDOW && state.remaining > 0) {
    transitionEl.classList.add("active");
  } else {
    transitionEl.classList.remove("active");
  }

  renderSubsteps();

  $("btn-prev").disabled = state.idx === 0;
  $("btn-play").textContent = state.running ? "\u23F8 Pause" : (state.remaining === PHASES[state.idx].duration ? "\u25B6 Start" : "\u25B6 Resume");
  $("status-line").textContent = state.running ? "Running" : (state.remaining === 0 ? "Phase complete" : "Paused");
}

function tick(ts) {
  if (!state.running) return;
  if (state.lastTick === null) state.lastTick = ts;
  const dt = (ts - state.lastTick) / 1000;
  state.lastTick = ts;
  state.remaining -= dt;
  if (state.remaining <= 0) {
    state.remaining = 0;
    state.running = false;
    update();
    return;
  }
  update();
  state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}

function play() {
  if (state.remaining <= 0) return;
  state.running = true;
  state.lastTick = null;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
  state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  update();
}
function pause() {
  state.running = false;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
  update();
}
function toggle() { state.running ? pause() : play(); }

function next() {
  if (state.idx < PHASES.length - 1) {
    state.idx++;
    state.remaining = PHASES[state.idx].duration;
    state.running = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
    renderPhase();
  }
}
function prev() {
  if (state.idx > 0) {
    state.idx--;
    state.remaining = PHASES[state.idx].duration;
    state.running = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
    renderPhase();
  }
}
function resetPhase() {
  state.remaining = PHASES[state.idx].duration;
  state.running = false;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
  update();
}
function restartAll() {
  state.idx = 0;
  state.remaining = PHASES[0].duration;
  state.running = false;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
  renderPhase();
}

$("btn-play").addEventListener("click", toggle);
$("btn-next").addEventListener("click", next);
$("btn-prev").addEventListener("click", prev);
$("btn-reset").addEventListener("click", resetPhase);
$("btn-restart-all").addEventListener("click", restartAll);

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.target.tagName === "INPUT" || e.target.tagName === "TEXTAREA") return;
  if (e.code === "Space") { e.preventDefault(); toggle(); }
  else if (e.code === "ArrowRight") { e.preventDefault(); next(); }
  else if (e.code === "ArrowLeft") { e.preventDefault(); prev(); }

const TRANSITION_WINDOW = 60;

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const state = {
  idx: 0,
  remaining: PHASES[0].duration,
  running: false,
  lastTick: null,
  rafId: null,
  mode: "fishing",
};

function setMode(m) {
  state.mode = m;
  const f = $("mode-fishing"), r = $("mode-racing"), note = $("mode-note");
  if (f && r && note) {
    f.classList.toggle("on", m === "fishing");
    r.classList.toggle("on", m === "racing");
    note.textContent = m === "fishing"
      ? "First time this week â€” Fishing Frenzy keeps energy playful."
      : "Repeat day â€” Racing is more rigorous; use when students need the faster pace.";
  }
}
window.setMode = setMode;

function fmt(s) {
  s = Math.max(0, Math.round(s));
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  const ss = s % 60;
  return `${m}:${ss.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function hueForRemaining(remaining, duration) {
  const frac = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, remaining / duration));
  return Math.round(210 * frac);
}

function renderDots() {
  const dots = $("dots");
  dots.innerHTML = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < PHASES.length; i++) {
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.className = "dot" + (i < state.idx ? " done" : i === state.idx ? " current" : "");
    dots.appendChild(d);
  }
}

function currentSubstep(phase, remaining) {
  if (!phase.substeps || !phase.substeps.length) return null;
  const elapsed = phase.duration - remaining;
  let acc = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < phase.substeps.length; i++) {
    acc += phase.substeps[i].sec;
    if (elapsed < acc) {
      return {index: i, remainingInStep: acc - elapsed};
    }
  }
  return {index: phase.substeps.length - 1, remainingInStep: 0};
}

function renderSubsteps() {
  const p = PHASES[state.idx];
  const list = $("substep-list");
  list.innerHTML = "";
  if (!p.substeps) return;
  const cur = currentSubstep(p, state.remaining);
  p.substeps.forEach((s, i) => {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    let cls = "substep";
    if (cur && i < cur.index) cls += " done";
    else if (cur && i === cur.index) cls += " current";
    div.className = cls;
    const text = document.createElement("div");
    text.className = "substep-text";
    text.textContent = s.label;
    const time = document.createElement("div");
    time.className = "substep-time";
    if (cur && i === cur.index) {
      time.textContent = fmt(cur.remainingInStep);
    } else {
      time.textContent = fmt(s.sec);
    }
    div.appendChild(text);
    div.appendChild(time);
    list.appendChild(div);
  });
}

function renderPhase() {
  const p = PHASES[state.idx];
  $("phase-meta").textContent = `Phase ${state.idx + 1} of ${PHASES.length}  Â·  Algebra 2  Â·  Lesson 3-5  Â·  Combined Day 2-3 (Savvas-only)`;
  $("phase-title").innerHTML =
    `${p.title}<span class="badge-row">` +
    `<span class="badge framework">${p.framework}</span>` +
    (p.dok === "â€”" ? `` : `<span class="badge">${p.dok}</span>`) +
    `<span class="badge" style="background:#555">${Math.round(p.duration/60)} min</span>` +
    `</span>`;
  $("instructions").innerHTML = p.instructions;
  $("transition-text").textContent = p.transition || "";
  renderDots();
  update();
  if (p.framework === "Do Now B") setMode(state.mode);
}

function update() {
  const p = PHASES[state.idx];
  const hue = hueForRemaining(state.remaining, p.duration);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--hue", hue);

  const pct = 100 * (1 - state.remaining / p.duration);
  $("progress-fill").style.width = pct.toFixed(1) + "%";
  $("timer").textContent = fmt(state.remaining);

  const transitionEl = $("transition");
  if (state.remaining <= TRANSITION_WINDOW && state.remaining > 0) {
    transitionEl.classList.add("active");
  } else {
    transitionEl.classList.remove("active");
  }

function currentSubstep(phase, remaining) {

  const elapsed = phase.duration - remaining;
  let acc = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < phase.substeps.length; i++) {
    acc += phase.substeps[i].sec;

    }
  }
  return {index: phase.substeps.length - 1, remainingInStep: 0};

// Phase total check (must equal 2700):
// 300 + 120 + 360 + 60 + 660 + 720 + 480 = 2700 s = 45 min âœ“

const TRANSITION_WINDOW = 60;

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const state = {
  idx: 0,
  remaining: PHASES[0].duration,
  running: false,
  lastTick: null,
  rafId: null,
  mode: "fishing",
};

function setMode(m) {
  state.mode = m;
  const f = $("mode-fishing"), r = $("mode-racing"), note = $("mode-note");
  if (f && r && note) {
    f.classList.toggle("on", m === "fishing");
    r.classList.toggle("on", m === "racing");
    note.textContent = m === "fishing"
      ? "First time this week â€” Fishing Frenzy keeps energy playful."
      : "Repeat day â€” Racing is more rigorous; use when students need the faster pace.";
  }
}
window.setMode = setMode;

function fmt(s) {
  s = Math.max(0, Math.round(s));
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  const ss = s % 60;
  return `${m}:${ss.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function hueForRemaining(remaining, duration) {
  const frac = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, remaining / duration));
  return Math.round(210 * frac);
}

function renderDots() {
  const dots = $("dots");
  dots.innerHTML = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < PHASES.length; i++) {
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.className = "dot" + (i < state.idx ? " done" : i === state.idx ? " current" : "");
    dots.appendChild(d);
  }
}

function currentSubstep(phase, remaining) {
  if (!phase.substeps || !phase.substeps.length) return null;
  const elapsed = phase.duration - remaining;
  let acc = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < phase.substeps.length; i++) {
    acc += phase.substeps[i].sec;
    if (elapsed < acc) {
      return {index: i, remainingInStep: acc - elapsed};
    }
  }
  return {index: phase.substeps.length - 1, remainingInStep: 0};
}

function renderSubsteps() {
  const p = PHASES[state.idx];
  const list = $("substep-list");
  list.innerHTML = "";
  if (!p.substeps) return;
  const cur = currentSubstep(p, state.remaining);
  p.substeps.forEach((s, i) => {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    let cls = "substep";
    if (cur && i < cur.index) cls += " done";
    else if (cur && i === cur.index) cls += " current";
    div.className = cls;
    const text = document.createElement("div");
    text.className = "substep-text";
    text.textContent = s.label;
    const time = document.createElement("div");
    time.className = "substep-time";
    if (cur && i === cur.index) {
      time.textContent = fmt(cur.remainingInStep);
    } else {
      time.textContent = fmt(s.sec);
    }
    div.appendChild(text);
    div.appendChild(time);
    list.appendChild(div);
  });
}

function renderPhase() {
  const p = PHASES[state.idx];
  $("phase-meta").textContent = `Phase ${state.idx + 1} of ${PHASES.length}  Â·  Algebra 2  Â·  Lesson 3-5  Â·  Combined Day 2-3  Â·  Compressed â€” F Wed 45 min`;
  $("phase-title").innerHTML =
    `${p.title}<span class="badge-row">` +
    `<span class="badge framework">${p.framework}</span>` +
    (p.dok === "â€”" ? `` : `<span class="badge">${p.dok}</span>`) +
    `<span class="badge" style="background:#555">${Math.round(p.duration/60)} min</span>` +
    `</span>`;
  $("instructions").innerHTML = p.instructions;
  $("transition-text").textContent = p.transition || "";
  renderDots();
  update();
  if (p.framework === "Do Now B") setMode(state.mode);
}

function update() {
  const p = PHASES[state.idx];
  const hue = hueForRemaining(state.remaining, p.duration);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--hue", hue);

  const pct = 100 * (1 - state.remaining / p.duration);
  $("progress-fill").style.width = pct.toFixed(1) + "%";
  $("timer").textContent = fmt(state.remaining);

  const transitionEl = $("transition");
  if (state.remaining <= TRANSITION_WINDOW && state.remaining > 0) {
    transitionEl.classList.add("active");
  } else {
    transitionEl.classList.remove("active");
  }

  renderSubsteps();

  $("btn-prev").disabled = state.idx === 0;
  $("btn-play").textContent = state.running ? "â¸ Pause" : (state.remaining === PHASES[state.idx].duration ? "â–¶ Start" : "â–¶ Resume");
  $("status-line").textContent = state.running ? "Running" : (state.remaining === 0 ? "Phase complete" : "Paused");
}

function tick(ts) {
  if (!state.running) return;
  if (state.lastTick === null) state.lastTick = ts;
  const dt = (ts - state.lastTick) / 1000;
  state.lastTick = ts;
  state.remaining -= dt;
  if (state.remaining <= 0) {
    state.remaining = 0;
    state.running = false;
    update();
    return;
  }
  update();
  state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}

function play() {
  if (state.remaining <= 0) return;
  state.running = true;
  state.lastTick = null;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
  state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  update();
}
function pause() {
  state.running = false;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
  update();
}
function toggle() { state.running ? pause() : play(); }

function next() {
  if (state.idx < PHASES.length - 1) {
    state.idx++;
    state.remaining = PHASES[state.idx].duration;
    state.running = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
    renderPhase();
  }
}
function prev() {
  if (state.idx > 0) {
    state.idx--;
    state.remaining = PHASES[state.idx].duration;
    state.running = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
    renderPhase();
  }
}
function resetPhase() {
  state.remaining = PHASES[state.idx].duration;
  state.running = false;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
  update();
}
function restartAll() {
  state.idx = 0;
  state.remaining = PHASES[0].duration;
  state.running = false;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
  renderPhase();
}

$("btn-play").addEventListener("click", toggle);
$("btn-next").addEventListener("click", next);
$("btn-prev").addEventListener("click", prev);
$("btn-reset").addEventListener("click", resetPhase);
$("btn-restart-all").addEventListener("click", restartAll);

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.target.tagName === "INPUT" || e.target.tagName === "TEXTAREA") return;
  if (e.code === "Space") { e.preventDefault(); toggle(); }
  else if (e.code === "ArrowRight") { e.preventDefault(); next(); }
  else if (e.code === "ArrowLeft") { e.preventDefault(); prev(); }
  else if (e.key === "r" || e.key === "R") { e.preventDefault(); resetPhase(); }
});

renderPhase();
</script>

const TRANSITION_WINDOW = 60;
// Quiz 5-minute warning fires when a phase has isQuiz=true and remaining â‰¤ 300s
const QUIZ_WARNING_SEC = 5 * 60;

const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const state = {
  idx: 0,
  remaining: PHASES[0].duration,
  running: false,
  lastTick: null,
  rafId: null,
};

function fmt(s) {
  s = Math.max(0, Math.round(s));
  const m = Math.floor(s / 60);
  const ss = s % 60;
  return `${m}:${ss.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function hueForRemaining(remaining, duration) {
  const frac = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, remaining / duration));
  return Math.round(210 * frac);
}

function renderDots() {
  const dots = $("dots");
  dots.innerHTML = "";
  for (let i = 0; i < PHASES.length; i++) {
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.className = "dot" + (i < state.idx ? " done" : i === state.idx ? " current" : "");
    dots.appendChild(d);
  }
}

function currentSubstep(phase, remaining) {
  if (!phase.substeps || !phase.substeps.length) return null;
  const elapsed = phase.duration - remaining;
  let acc = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < phase.substeps.length; i++) {
    acc += phase.substeps[i].sec;
    if (elapsed < acc) {
      return {index: i, remainingInStep: acc - elapsed};
    }
  }
  return {index: phase.substeps.length - 1, remainingInStep: 0};
}

function renderSubsteps() {
  const p = PHASES[state.idx];
  const list = $("substep-list");
  list.innerHTML = "";
  if (!p.substeps) return;
  const cur = currentSubstep(p, state.remaining);
  p.substeps.forEach((s, i) => {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    let cls = "substep";
    if (cur && i < cur.index) cls += " done";
    else if (cur && i === cur.index) cls += " current";
    div.className = cls;
    const text = document.createElement("div");
    text.className = "substep-text";
    text.textContent = s.label;
    const time = document.createElement("div");
    time.className = "substep-time";
    if (cur && i === cur.index) {
      time.textContent = fmt(cur.remainingInStep);
    } else {
      time.textContent = fmt(s.sec);
    }
    div.appendChild(text);
    div.appendChild(time);
    list.appendChild(div);
  });
}

function renderPhase() {
  const p = PHASES[state.idx];
  $("phase-meta").textContent = `Phase ${state.idx + 1} of ${PHASES.length}  Â·  Algebra 2  Â·  Lesson 3-5  Â·  Day 8 (Savvas-only)`;
  $("phase-title").innerHTML =
    `${p.title}<span class="badge-row">` +
    `<span class="badge framework">${p.framework}</span>` +
    (p.dok === "â€”" ? `` : `<span class="badge">${p.dok}</span>`) +
    `<span class="badge" style="background:#555">${Math.round(p.duration/60)} min</span>` +
    `</span>`;
  $("instructions").innerHTML = p.instructions;
  $("transition-text").textContent = p.transition || "";
  renderDots();
  update();
}

function update() {
  const p = PHASES[state.idx];
  const hue = hueForRemaining(state.remaining, p.duration);
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--hue", hue);

  const pct = 100 * (1 - state.remaining / p.duration);
  $("progress-fill").style.width = pct.toFixed(1) + "%";
  $("timer").textContent = fmt(state.remaining);

  const transitionEl = $("transition");
  if (state.remaining <= TRANSITION_WINDOW && state.remaining > 0) {
    transitionEl.classList.add("active");
  } else {
    transitionEl.classList.remove("active");
  }

  // Quiz 5-minute warning
  const warningEl = $("quiz-warning");
  if (p.isQuiz && state.remaining <= QUIZ_WARNING_SEC && state.remaining > 0) {
    warningEl.classList.add("show");
  } else {
    warningEl.classList.remove("show");
  }

  renderSubsteps();

  $("btn-prev").disabled = state.idx === 0;
  $("btn-play").textContent = state.running ? "â¸ Pause" : (state.remaining === PHASES[state.idx].duration ? "â–¶ Start" : "â–¶ Resume");
  $("status-line").textContent = state.running ? "Running" : (state.remaining === 0 ? "Phase complete" : "Paused");
}

function tick(ts) {
  if (!state.running) return;
  if (state.lastTick === null) state.lastTick = ts;
  const dt = (ts - state.lastTick) / 1000;
  state.lastTick = ts;
  state.remaining -= dt;
  if (state.remaining <= 0) {
    state.remaining = 0;
    state.running = false;
    update();
    return;
  }
  update();
  state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}

function play() {
  if (state.remaining <= 0) return;
  state.running = true;
  state.lastTick = null;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
  state.rafId = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  update();
}
function pause() {
  state.running = false;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
  update();
}
function toggle() { state.running ? pause() : play(); }

function next() {
  if (state.idx < PHASES.length - 1) {
    state.idx++;
    state.remaining = PHASES[state.idx].duration;
    state.running = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
    renderPhase();
  }
}
function prev() {
  if (state.idx > 0) {
    state.idx--;
    state.remaining = PHASES[state.idx].duration;
    state.running = false;
    cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
    renderPhase();
  }
}
function resetPhase() {
  state.remaining = PHASES[state.idx].duration;
  state.running = false;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
  update();
}
function restartAll() {
  state.idx = 0;
  state.remaining = PHASES[0].duration;
  state.running = false;
  cancelAnimationFrame(state.rafId);
  renderPhase();
}

$("btn-play").addEventListener("click", toggle);
$("btn-next").addEventListener("click", next);
$("btn-prev").addEventListener("click", prev);
$("btn-reset").addEventListener("click", resetPhase);
$("btn-restart-all").addEventListener("click", restartAll);

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.target.tagName === "INPUT" || e.target.tagName === "TEXTAREA") return;
  if (e.code === "Space") { e.preventDefault(); toggle(); }
  else if (e.code === "ArrowRight") { e.preventDefault(); next(); }
  else if (e.code === "ArrowLeft") { e.preventDefault(); prev(); }
  else if (e.key === "r" || e.key === "R") { e.preventDefault(); resetPhase(); }
});

renderPhase();
</script>

def split_phase_objects(arr_text):
    objs=[]

    for i,ch in enumerate(arr_text):

            elif ch==in_str:
                in_str=None
            continue
